minister.name: Youns Bjijou
minister.role: Minister of Health and Social Protection

snapshot.text: Morocco is extending mandatory health insurance (AMO) to the whole population and reorganising care through regional territorial health groups. A new government under Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, the country's first female head of government, took office on 16 October 2026.

priorities.title: A new minister from science and health
priorities.text: Youns Bjijou, previously managing director of the Mohammed VI Foundation for Science and Health, succeeded Amine Tehraoui; his task is to turn health investments into better services for patients.

priorities.title: Territorial health groups
priorities.text: The reform creating regional territorial health groups faces its first real test in the field.

priorities.title: New hospitals and emergency care
priorities.text: Fifteen hospital projects are due in 2026, along with 67 new health centres in six regions, while a reform plan targets overcrowded emergency rooms.

netherlands.text: Political ties are warm: after Foreign Minister Berendsen's visit in April 2026 both sides agreed to sign a multi-sectoral action plan in 2026 and a roadmap for cooperation. No specific health track found; the large Moroccan-Dutch community is a recurring theme.
